options.text: Unrelated diversification into a new industry
options.misconception: The supplier is part of the same value chain

options.text: Forward vertical integration, gaining control of distribution
options.misconception: Suppliers are upstream, not downstream

options.text: Horizontal integration, acquiring a competing firm
options.misconception: The acquired firm is a supplier, not a rival

options.text: Backward vertical integration, gaining control of inputs

questions.explanation: Backward vertical integration means acquiring control of suppliers or inputs that feed the business. Forward integration concerns distribution toward customers, horizontal integration involves rivals, and this move stays within the existing value chain.
questions.hint: Owning an upstream supplier is backward integration.
